content:
More than 150 pets in Laredo received food in October through a Webb County Meals on Wheels program built on a simple idea: older adults should not have to choose between feeding themselves and feeding their pets, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The Meals on Wheels Pets Program is run by Webb County Meals on Wheels, under the Webb County Community Action Agency, in collaboration with Pets Alive Laredo and Laredo Animal Care Services. Mary Bender with Pets Alive Laredo spoke about the program, the Times reported.

The program launched in late August 2026, with its first official service day on Sept. 28, 2026. Participating older adults who already receive Meals on Wheels services also receive pet food and related support, so they can keep caring for their animals at home.

More than 150 pets received food during October, the Times reported. The article did not list a donation link, drop-off location, or volunteer sign-up, so Webb Watch is not publishing one here.

Sources:

  • Laredo Morning Times, "More than 150 pets receive food through Laredo Meals on Wheels program," November 1, 2026

title: More than 150 pets fed through Laredo Meals on Wheels program
